title: From Lab to Reality: A Practical Evaluation of Deep Learning Models and LLMs for Vulnerability Detection
abstract: arXiv:2512.10485v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vulnerability detection methods based on deep learning (DL) have shown strong performance on benchmark datasets, yet their real-world effectiveness remains underexplored. Recent work suggests that graph neural network-based and transformer-based models, including large language models (LLMs), yield promising results when evaluated on curated benchmark datasets. These datasets are typically characterized by similar data distributions and may contain synthetic samples, heuristic labels, or labeling noise. translated_title: 从实验室到现实：深度学习模型与LLMs在漏洞检测中的实用评估
translated_abstract: 基于深度学习（DL）的漏洞检测方法在基准数据集上表现出强大性能，但其在现实世界中的有效性仍未得到充分探索。近期研究表明，基于图神经网络和Transformer的模型，包括大型语言模型（LLMs），在精选的基准数据集上评估时能产生令人满意的结果。这些数据集通常具有相似的数据分布，可能包含合成样本、启发式标签或标签噪声。在本研究中，我们系统评估了四种代表性DL模型——Devign、ReVeal、LineVul和VulBERTa——在四个代表性数据集上：Juliet、Devign、BigVul和ICVul。每个模型在每个数据集上独立训练，并使用t-SNE和质心距离分析这些模型采用的基于图和CodeBERT的表示，以检查与漏洞相关的模式。为了评估现实应用的适用性，我们进一步进行了跨数据集实验和实际场景模拟。
tldr: 本文系统评估了四种深度学习漏洞检测模型在多个数据集上的表现，通过跨数据集实验和可视化分析揭示了基准测试与真实世界应用之间的性能差距，强调了模型泛化能力的挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically evaluates four deep learning vulnerability detection models across multiple datasets, revealing performance gaps between benchmarks and real-world applications through cross-dataset experiments and visualization analysis, highlighting challenges in model generalization.
